activities.name: Moraine Lake road, Banff
activities.note: the road is the only vehicle access; in winter the lake is reached on snowshoes, fat bike or skis

windows.reason: Parks Canada closes the road for the season from around Canadian Thanksgiving in mid-October until early June, with the exact date set by snowfall
the closing and reopening months — in 2026 the Lake Louise and Moraine Lake shuttles finished on 12 October

activities.name: Icefields Parkway attractions
activities.note: the highway itself stays open through the winter — it is the attractions along it that do not

windows.reason: the Skywalk, the Glacier Adventure and the Icefields Discovery Centre all close for the winter, and the drive itself needs a road-condition check after snow
